correctness.rationale: Precisely identified the complete 2-binomial signature (weight, 01 subsequence count). Gaussian-binomial coefficients enumerate each fiber. Theorem 4.5 (Canfield–Janson–Zeilberger) applies uniformly in a binomial central window; uniform squared local masses, a Chebyshev tail bound, and the exact variance k(n-k)(n+1)/12 yield conditional collision (2 sqrt(3)/sqrt(pi))n^(-3/2). Vandermonde and binomial concentration supply 1/sqrt(pi n); the final constant follows. The standalone source at verify.py reproduces DP through 100 and direct all-word signatures through length 12. The proof, not the tests, establishes the asymptotic.
